    Theorem 4.5: the string and band classification #

    Over an algebraically closed field k, for monomial data D with a sign choice S (a string algebra):

    • every indecomposable finite-dimensional module is a string module M(w) or a band module M(ω, μ, n) (string_or_band);
    • for a band ω and n ≥ 1, the band modules M(ω, μ, n), μ ∈ kˣ, are indecomposable and pairwise nonisomorphic (isIndecomposable_bandModule, eq_of_bandModule_equiv);
    • a representation-finite string algebra has no bands (not_isRepFinite_of_band), and every indecomposable module is a string module (string_of_isRepFinite).

    Here a band is a cyclic word that alternates for S, kills zero paths, and is primitive (CWord.Alt, CWord.KillsZero, injectivity of CWord.rightW).

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.string_or_band {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [IsAlgClosed k] {D : MonomialData k B} (S : D.Signs) (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module k M] [IsScalarTower k B M] [FiniteDimensional k M] (hM : Statement.IsIndecomposable B M) :
    (∃ (w : Word D.Q) (hs : Word.IsString D w), Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[B] Word.stringModule D w hs)) ∨ ∃ (b : CWord D.Q) (hA : CWord.Alt S b) (hK : b.KillsZero) (_ : ∀ (p q : Fin b.n), b.rightW p = b.rightW q → p = q) (n : ℕ) (_ : 0 < n) (μ : kˣ), Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[B] CWord.bandModule S b hA hK n μ)

    Theorem 4.5, first part. Over an algebraically closed field, every indecomposable finite-dimensional module over a string algebra is a string module or a band module M(ω, μ, n).

    theorem BrickAccessibility.not_isRepFinite_of_band {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [IsAlgClosed k] {D : MonomialData k B} (S : D.Signs) (b : CWord D.Q) (hA : CWord.Alt S b) (hK : b.KillsZero) (hprim : ∀ (p q : Fin b.n), b.rightW p = b.rightW q → p = q) :
    ¬IsRepFinite B

    Theorem 4.5, last part. A representation-finite string algebra has no bands: the band modules M(ω, μ, 1), μ ∈ kˣ, are infinitely many pairwise nonisomorphic indecomposables.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.string_of_isRepFinite {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [IsAlgClosed k] {D : MonomialData k B} (S : D.Signs) (hrf : IsRepFinite B) (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module k M] [IsScalarTower k B M] [FiniteDimensional k M] (hM : Statement.IsIndecomposable B M) :
    ∃ (w : Word D.Q) (hs : Word.IsString D w), Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[B] Word.stringModule D w hs)

    Theorem 4.5, last part. Over a representation-finite string algebra every indecomposable module is a string module.
